name: cook-pi-extension
description: cook pi extension. package.json is dev-only: it pins @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent (published on npm), @earendil-works/pi-tui (the tool renderers' components; not resolvable transitively -- pi keeps it nested under pi-coding-agent), and typebox so `npx tsc --noEmit` resolves pi's real types. At runtime pi provides these imports itself.
